overview: DesignIQ is a premium AI-powered exam preparation platform for UCEED, NID, and NIFT design entrance exams. It features an interactive AI Mentor chat, personalized study tools, mock tests, analytics, and a sleek SaaS EdTech interface.
features: AI Mentor Chat — ask any exam question and get live AI answers
Explore Exams — deep-dive pages for UCEED, NID, and NIFT
Free Trial — 7-day trial with full feature access
Explore Features — feature grid with AI Tools, Analytics, Practice, and Learning categories
Sign In — Internet Identity and phone OTP authentication
Premium glassmorphism UI with Deep Indigo, Electric Purple, and Soft Cyan palette
